method: Single-author seed set. Each case was constructed so the correct verdict follows mechanically from the 9.2 anchors — 'is this evidence present, and does it carry depth, scope or duration' — rather than from any view about whether the candidate is suitable. Resumes are synthetic.
adjudication: None. One labeller, so there is nothing to adjudicate and no inter-rater agreement to report.
caveats: NOT A SUBSTITUTE FOR 18.1. This exists so the harness has something to run against and so regressions are caught; it is not evidence of accuracy on real applications. Before any figure from this set is quoted in support of a hiring decision it must be replaced by real CVs labelled independently by at least two people, with Cohen's kappa reported alongside accuracy and disagreements retained. Synthetic single-role resumes are also systematically easier than real ones: no career changes, no ambiguous titles, no second-language phrasing, no 12-page academic CVs.
